Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right-hand lane of a Baytown, Texas roadway when Driver 2 moved left into the same
space without signaling and struck the side of Driver 1's vehicle. Both vehicles remained on scene and the contact left
a clear pattern of scraping and crushed panels along the driver's side of Driver 1's car, consistent with the sideswipe
described by both drivers. Driver 2 acknowledged changing lanes and did not dispute how the collision occurred. Two
independent witnesses in a nearby veihcle gave statements that matched the account, and photographs taken at the
scene show the damage in the same location and direction both drivers reported. Officers confirmed Passenger was
seated in the front passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the left
knee, which fits the force of a side impact against the door and lower dash area. No prior damage to the vehicle was
noted during the inspection, and Driver 1 is listed as an insured driver on the policy covering the vehicle. No citations
were issued at the scene pending further review.
